notes: Payloads captured by running resumeRuntimeAgentRun against the real signer with fetch stubbed, then decoding the Authorization bearer it sent; the volatile iat/exp claims are stripped.

A run whose record carries an agentId, an actor service account and an actor agent access grant gets the runScoped shape via mintRunScopedServiceAccountToken. Every other project-bound run gets the projectScoped shape via mintProjectScopedServiceToken. resumeRuntimeAgentRun refuses a projectless run before it mints anything, so there is no projectless resume shape.

Both shapes carry the same nine RUNTIME_SCOPES.runsResume scopes, but not in the same order: getProjectScopedServiceTokenScopes filters and sorts, while the run-scoped mint passes the requested list through unchanged. Scope comparison must be order insensitive.

grantId, relation and jti are per-mint or per-grant values, so only their presence and type are contractual. relation in particular reflects the collaborator's grant on the project and must not be pinned to a value: the API decides who may resume, and this contract records only the claim shape it signs.
The scope sets of runsResume and runsStream are equal, so a run's own invocation bearer satisfies this contract for that same run. Both are bound to one runId, so this is not cross-run authority.
